proposals.title: Review rule: auction warning
proposals.content:
When writing or revising, guard against this recurring issue: auction warning.
Preferred correction: Add one consequence that directly threatens the protagonist if they ignore the auction.
Observed evidence: The letter warns that the auction decides control of the city, but the protagonist's personal risk is still abstract.

source_finding.evidence: The letter warns that the auction decides control of the city, but the protagonist's personal risk is still abstract.
